view.name: Client Board Ops
view.description: Weekday client-board automation: sync Trello to a tasks sheet each morning, email a status digest, and check the inbox for replies that create or update work.

memory.content: Owns one client project board’s weekday ops loop: morning board↔tasks sync, daily client status email, and daytime inbox reply checks.
Green label means ready to work; yellow means needs more information. Status field on tasks mirrors board list names.
Status emails use dark text on a light header (clients often strip dark backgrounds). Sign as the user’s AI assistant and invite replies to change or add items.
Requires Gmail and Google Drive connectors, plus a Trello connector (official Trello MCP at https://mcp.trello.com/v1 or equivalent).
